core_meaning.primary_meaning: Assel is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Honey”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Assel corresponds to the Arabic form عَسَل (Arabic root ع س ل (ʿ-s-l); عَسَل (ʿAsal)). Its core sense is assel; honey (central asian form). Assel is the Central Asian form of Arabic عَسَل (ʿAsal), meaning 'honey'. It is used as a female given name.
